requisitionList.Title: Software Designer Co-op/Intern
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Position: Software Designer Co-op/Intern

Number of Position(s): 1

Duration: 4 Months

Date: May 4 - August 28, 2026 (Summer Term)

Location: Hybrid in Ottawa Office

requisitionList.Title: Automation Engineer Co-op/Intern
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Join Nokia’s Network Infrastructure team and gain hands-on experience in network automation and orchestration! As a Co-op/Intern, you’ll work alongside experts to develop tools and custom scripts using Python, Ansible, and other technologies that power Nokia’s IP Networking and Data Center solutions. This role offers the opportunity to learn how automation transforms large-scale networks, collaborate with senior engineers, and contribute to real customer deployments. If you’re curious, detail-oriented, and eager to grow your skills in scripting, networking, and automation, this is the perfect chance to kickstart your career in a global tech leader.

requisitionList.Title: Customer Applications Eng Co-op/Intern
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
This is a great opportunity to be part of a team supporting Nokia’s industry-leading network management platforms. 
You will work in a fast-paced environment, applying your technical expertise to solve real-world customer challenges and gain hands-on experience with Nokia’s latest network management, automation, and routing products. Every day will bring new challenges, providing exposure to cutting-edge technologies used in top ISP networks. 
Your skills in Linux, Java, and networking will be put to the test, allowing you to expand your knowledge and make a meaningful impact in the evolving world of network infrastructure.

requisitionList.Title: Network Management Integration Co-op/Intern
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: As a Network Management Integration Intern at Nokia, you will join a global team of engineers deploying cutting-edge network management solutions for our customers. During your 4-month term, you will work on assigned projects with clear goals, assist with lab tasks, and gain hands-on experience with Nokia’s latest technologies, including Linux systems, virtualization (Docker/Kubernetes), and networking protocols. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop skills in system integration, automation, and software troubleshooting in a hybrid work environment.

requisitionList.Title: Security Software Developer Co-Op/Intern
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Join Nokia’s Cloud and Network Services team and help build secure, innovative solutions for the future. As a Security Software Developer Co-op/Intern, you’ll work with the Common Software Foundation team to design and develop reusable security components that power our global product portfolio. This is your chance to gain hands-on experience in cybersecurity, collaborate with talented engineers, and contribute to technologies that protect critical networks worldwide. If you’re curious, proactive, and ready to turn ideas into impact, we’d love to have you on board!

requisitionList.Title: Autonomous Network Fabric Eng Student
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Join our Autonomous Network R&D team to contribute to the software development lifecycle. Work on creating innovative software applications while gaining valuable experience. Research and develop applications and use cases. Create unit, functional, and system-level test cases to validate functionality. Assist with the preparation of design documentation. Support design and implementation specifications to ensure high-quality outcomes. This role offers an opportunity to develop technical skills, work collaboratively, and be part of impactful projects in a cutting-edge field.

requisitionList.Title: Business Ops Analyst Co-op/Intern
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: This is a great opportunity to contribute to improving the software delivery experience for Nokia’s customers. You will collaborate closely with Business Operations Managers, testers, and end users to analyze how software is being utilized and identify opportunities for enhancement. Your work will help streamline delivery processes, support the creation of automated reporting tools across various systems, and ensure alignment with best practices. You will play a key role in supporting Nokia’s goal of delivering high-quality software efficiently and effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

requisitionList.Title: Test Developer Co-op/Intern
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Join our passionate team of engineers as a QA Test Engineer, working on the innovative 7705 Service Aggregation Router (SAR) family of products. You'll play a vital role in testing and qualifying advanced components and features, ensuring they meet the highest standards. Collaborate closely with Software, Hardware, Firmware, and Product Management teams to design, develop, and execute sophisticated tests. We value expertise and simplicity, enabling you to focus on coding and delivering outstanding results. If you're excited about cutting-edge technology and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment, we’d love to have you on board.

requisitionList.Title: User Experience Designer Co-op/Intern
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: This is a great opportunity to be part of Nokia's UX design team. You will play an integral role in creating UX specifications for web-based applications, ensuring they are user-centered and align with Nokia's design system. Your expertise in user-centered design principles will be key in delivering creative and innovative solutions. You will have the chance to contribute both independently and collaboratively, demonstrating strong communication skills and taking the initiative in your design work. Your contributions will help drive consistency and enhance the overall user experience across Nokia’s products.
